rows.text: Roll again if the captain is at a space port, otherwise an Objective Item has been found that may be required for the current mission (check the away mission’s details). If it’s not needed, it is in- stead an ancient alien artefact (AAA) worth 75c.
Use to gain +3 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon.
Use to gain +3 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon.
Use to add +3 Def against enemy’s next damage roll.
Roll on table A – Armour and add “(L)” before its name. It gains +0.4 Def and gains +200 credit to its value and 40 credits to its fix cost.
Use to deduct -4 pips from the acid track.
Use to replenish up to 8 lost HP.
Use to add +15 Int to next test.
Use to add +15 Str to next test.
Use to add +15 Dex to next test.
Use to deduct -4 pips from the plague track.
Roll on table I – Implants +5 for the patch that is found. Add “Patch” after its name when you add it to the log sheet.
Use to add +15 to a result when rolling on the next table.
Use to gain 2 karma point.
Use to gain +15 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +15 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +15 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain 2 point of primary Dex.
Use to gain 2 point of primary Int.
Use to gain 2 point of primary Str.
Use to gain 2 point of primary HP.
Roll on table W – Weapon and add “(L)” before its name. Add +3 to its Dmg value. It gains +900 credit to its value.
Roll on table I – Implants +5 for the implant that is found.
Use to gain 2 Life point.
A more valuable trapping has been found. Roll on table TC – Trappings C
Powered armour has been found. Roll on table A – Armour +5 for the armour and then on table P - Powers +5 for its power and adjust its value.
A powered weapon has been found. Roll on table W – Weapons +5 for the weapon and then on table P - Powers +5 for its power and adjust its value.
